summary: MaintTemplates is an ASP.NET web page and supporting code for maintaining template records in a grid interface. Users can view, search, add, edit, and delete templates. The system supports error and warning handling, validation, and modal detail views for record editing.
purpose: To allow authorized users to manage template records (add, edit, delete) used elsewhere in the system via a searchable, grid-based web interface. Provides validation and feedback to ensure data integrity.

entities.name: TemplateRecord
entities.description: Represents a single template, including Name, Template, and TemplateAlt fields.

entities.name: Templates
entities.description: Collection and data access layer for TemplateRecord entries.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Primary key for template record, hidden in UI.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the template. Required, max length 50.

fields.name: Template
fields.description: Main template text. Required, multiline textbox.

fields.name: TemplateAlt
fields.description: Alternate locale text for the template. Required, multiline textbox.

fields.name: Keyword
fields.description: Search keyword used to filter templates.

workflows.name: Template Maintenance
steps: User loads page; data is refreshed and displayed in grid.
User searches using a keyword (optional; defaults to '%').
User clicks Add, Edit, or Delete for a template row.
Add/Edit: Modal details panel pops up with data fields.
On Save, data is persisted (Add or Update) and grid refreshed.
On Delete, confirmation is shown and record is removed.
Errors and warnings are shown in panels as needed.
Page supports AJAX updates for smooth operation.

business_rules: Name, Template, and TemplateAlt fields are mandatory.
Keyword search defaults to '%' if empty.
Data is refreshed after every modification.
Errors and warnings are presented in designated panels.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator to ensure Name, Template, TemplateAlt are not empty.
calculations: Template and TemplateAlt fields are truncated for display (75 chars in Grid).
ID is parsed from CommandArgument for actions.
conditions: If txtKeyword is empty, search uses '%'.
If IsPostBack is false, RefreshData() and focus on txtKeyword.
If Page.IsValid on Save, record is added/updated.
system_behavior: AJAX panels for error/warning and modal popups.
Grid and modal detail views auto-refresh after actions.
Panels display error/warning messages based on state.
MasterPage integration for layout and shared controls.
Auto-generated fields for UI controls, accessible in code-behind.
exceptions: If casting of keys fails, no data is loaded.
If required fields are not filled, validation error is shown.
If user is not authenticated, actions may be blocked.
content_gaps: No explicit information about permission checks or user roles beyond UserSession.
No details about how templates are used elsewhere in the system.
No sample template data or format.
